entities.name: Jaroslava Moserová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslava Moserová was a Czech politician, diplomat, translator and screenwriter. She was originally a plastic surgeon with a specialisation in skin burns. She was an unsuccessful presidential candidate in the 2003 Czech presidential election.
